description: You are a professional interpreter preparing for an international simultaneous interpretation conference session. Using Jitsi Meet at http://localhost:8080, set up a complete and secure meeting room for the conference. The meeting room name must be 'RSI-IntlConf-2024'. You need to activate all available security controls — including the waiting room/lobby feature and meeting password/room-lock protection — configure your display name to reflect your professional role as 'Lead Interpreter EN/FR', ensure the audio environment is controlled for interpretation quality by enabling the setting that makes all participants start with their microphone muted, and copy the meeting invitation link to clipboard so it can be distributed. Finally, document the complete meeting configuration in a report file at /home/ga/Desktop/rsi_conference_report.txt. The report must be comprehensive enough for a conference coordinator to send to all parties: include the full meeting URL, which security features are enabled, participant access instructions, and any audio/mute policies in place.
